{{Top|leg}}
'''Linzre''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Linzre warned users of the datalog that the insulation in [[stun gauntlet]]s could break down, especially in [[Species/Legends|species]] with acidic skin oils or perspiration.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
